posts.author: Phantasmagoric
posts.body:
Hello everyone! I've been on this forum for over 3 years and on the RPGM community for over 10, and yet I seemingly never made an introduction post!
Well, better late than never! I would love to make friends with other fellow RPG Maker devs, and maybe people with similar tastes. And I'll also take this opportunity to share a bit about all of my many ideas, even the ones I'm not actively developing right now, just because they also help to know me a little better!
First of all, I'm brazilian, so portuguese is my first language. My name is Victor, I'm 24 and recently married! I have 3 cats, I like anime, cartoons, speedrun content, analog horror, creepypastas, sci-fi, nonsense humor... besides JRPGs I also like League of Legends, platformers and especially retro gaming in general! Feel free to hit me up on Discord, it's
phantasmagoric
Without further ado, here's a little bit about my projects if you're interested:
Spoiler:
Perpetua (RPG Maker) - In Development
A multiversal tale about three different heroines from different backgrounds and
different realities
, who enter the dungeon of Perpetua for their own reasons, but who will all be faced with the same challenges inside the dungeon that ever was, ever will be, and is everywhere.
Three different parties with their own progress, their own variations of challenges and enemies, switch at any time
Explore the dungeon of Perpetua fighting ghosts of fallen heroes in randomly generated mazes, or progress through the floors by vanquishing the bosses and dungeons at any order
No shops, every merchant provides you with supplies and functionalities in unique ways...
Spoiler:
Legends Saga (RPG Maker) - A whole ass series
A project to utilize RTP resources in original stories, in a fantasy world where concepts such as "protagonists" and "EXP" are actual things, and as you follow the overarching story of a chosen hero turned into a mad king and his plots throughout generations of other heroes.
[*]Every game was supposed to utilize a different engine to showcase the different generations of heroes, and use a different core mechanic/battle system: from front-based turn RPG to action RPG or tactics.
[*]The main part already in development is Mob Hero Story, the one that DOESN'T utilize RTP heroes: about an ambitious mercenary and the party he assembles to enter the tournament of realm defenders - comprised of a slime, a goblin, an orc, and others...
Spoiler:
Babylon (RPG Maker) - My biggest and oldest project
My most ambitious project and the oldest one in development, I even had an old beta released but have since started remaking the game from scratch with one of the most developed worldbuildings and lore from all of my projects. It has two parts planned,
Path of Exorcism
and
The Mask Collector
, a prequel.
Path of Exorcism
is about a modern society in a dystopic scenario where the Church is the greatest military and political power and cities are protected by magical barriers, and a group of teenagers chosen to be trained on the Babylon Academy for Exorcists due to their powers in order to prepare agains the Third Holy War once the Demon General Belial re-awakens from his 15 year seal after the Second War.
[*]Strong inspiration from Persona, Mana Khemia, Danganronpa: Character relationships and quests are important - you can develop relationships with your party members and even NPCs.
[*]A long overarching school life taking place over 3 years
[*]No classes, every character has a unique gameplay style and abilities
[*]Highly customizable builds with skill trees, various types of equipments, etc.
[*]Linear story but very open options with secret passages in dungeons, secret bosses, optional dungeons and sidequests
[*]Large roster of demons and even human enemies
Spoiler:
Angelis Elementaria (Novel) - My first ever story
My oldest story ever, and one I've struggled for a while to find the medium for. I tried making it at a game back on VX Ace, perhaps it has a place as a game too, but for now it's a novel. Also has a deep lore and mythological inspirations from various cultures, as well as clear shounen anime vibes.
[*]Story of maturing focused on a group of childhood friends who are half-angels, born to legendary defenders of humanity and who believed they didn't inherit elemental powers
[*]Cosmic mythology, angels, demons, monsters, vampires, robots!
[*]All with typical shounen anime antics - training arc, so many characters, romance, comedy!
Spoiler:
Carothea (Novel) - In Development
The novel I'm writing atm, it's a slightly more serious but still very
shounen
story set in a cyberpunk dystopia where radioactive minerals can give people psychic powers and an optimistic scientist, a tsundere mercenary, a traumatized lab rat, a renegade knight and an amnesiac prisoner all come together to start a revolution.
Spoiler:
The Loreking (Novel) - Harem with mythologies
No plans to start writing it anytime soon, but figured I should mention it anyway. It's a story about a boy who finds the Loreking's quill, and has the mission to save both his worlds and the Bookworlds from dimensional rifts, all while becoming allies/friends/lovers with the princesses from the books: each world being based on a mythology - greek, celtic, brazilian, japanese, yoruba, etc.
I know this was a long read, but I hope something interested you! Hope we can be friends!
(I suck at formatting this many spoilers, sorry. Help.)
